Chapter 939: Chapter 5 The Eleventh-Level Citizen Of The Tenth Rank Of Human Civilization (Please Subscribe) - Part 2

Chapter 939: Chapter 5 The Eleventh-Level Citizen of the Tenth Rank of Human Civilization (Please Subscribe) – Part 2

The remaining Twelve-Star Ultimates were immediately shocked, realizing too well the impact these rule models could have on a species.

“Where are those rule models?”

“Have they been replicated?”

The Insect Queen quickly asked.

“Unable to replicate, the person I arranged to purchase the Level Eleven Chapter died completely after leaving the information.”

The Tianyu Clan Ancestor spoke briefly.

“I also sent someone to buy.”

The Insect Queen and other Twelve-Star Ultimates immediately made contact; if what the Tianyu Clan Ancestor said was true, even if it meant sacrificing a Tenth-Level ‘spy’, they needed to confirm it.

Shortly after.

One by one, the Twelve-Star Ultimates opened their eyes.

They soon discovered that the ‘spies’ who purchased the Level Eleven Chapter also died completely.

However, they did not care about these, because the information the ‘spies’ sent back matched what the Tianyu Clan Ancestor had said.

“So many rule models? And a Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Model? Who on earth is the founder of the Martial Tao evolutionary path?”

“Is there a problem with the rule models in the Level Eleven Chapter? After all, we haven’t seen those rule models with our own eyes.”

“The possibility of a problem is low. The fact that human civilization dares to openly publicize the Martial Tao Level Eleven Chapter means it has widespread applicability, suitable for the majority of life forms to comprehend.”

…

The Twelve-Star Ultimates quickly exchanged messages.

Rule models are not textual information; even if seen a few times, they cannot be described, written down, or spread.

But all the peak species factions’ ‘spies’ who purchased the Level Eleven Chapter left the same information, plus the continuous dissemination of the Martial Tao Level Eleven Chapter within human civilization.

It led each Twelve-Star Ultimate to realize that those rule models were real.

“Who exactly is it? Who on earth created the Martial Tao evolutionary path?”

“Xuanyuan Supreme? Impossible, he doesn’t have the ability. From the First Realm to the Fifth Realm of time and space rule models, even a Peak Path Splitting Realm cannot perfect it.”

Many Twelve-Star Ultimates felt a mix of shock and anger.

With these rule models, the evolutionary path of human cultivators will be much simpler than theirs from different species, increasing the number of Level Eleven Perfects and the likelihood of birthing an Ultimate.

The most critical point is, who exactly is the founder who created the Martial Tao evolutionary path?

“Search, search at all costs.”

“Yes, we must find out the identity of this founder of the evolutionary path.”

The dozen or so Twelve-Star Ultimates glanced at each other and their forms quickly vanished; they had already returned to their clans, using all their intelligence and information capabilities to search for information about the founder of the Martial Tao evolutionary path.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan introspects the changes in his internal world.

In just a few days, his internal world had expanded again, from the original two light-years in diameter to 2.1 light-years.

Do not underestimate the mere increase of 0.1, keep in mind the unit here is light-years!

“Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed; after comprehending the Chaos Rule, his perspective on the rules of the world around him changed, viewing them from a more fundamental level.

“This World Tree?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze landed on the towering giant tree at the center of his internal world.

At this moment, between the branches and leaves of the World Tree, many fruits were formed, each containing a miniaturized world within, offering many benefits for Seventh-Layer evolvers to advance their internal worlds in advance.

“According to the records of the Profound Xuanhuang, a strong practitioner in the Chaos Realm can mobilize a great amount of Chaotic Power, nurturing the World Tree to transform into a Chaos Tree?”

If the World Tree is considered an Eleven-Star superior treasure, then the Chaos Tree is a Twelve-Star superior treasure, and even for a Chaos Realm strong practitioner, it requires a great deal of time and energy to nurture a Chaos Tree.

“Let’s try it now.”

Lin Yuan immediately began operating the Chaos Rule, gathering Chaotic Power to nurture the World Tree.

The uses of the Chaos Tree are too many; it can preside over the internal universe and even enable the internal universe to expand outwardly.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan glanced at his own merit points balance.

One hundred trillion and one thousand five hundred trillion.

The one hundred trillion merit points were earned by Lin Yuan for uploading the ‘Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter’, and the excess one thousand five hundred trillion came from earlier.

“Directly promote to a Tenth-Level Citizen.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

For Ninth-Level Citizens to be promoted to Tenth-Level Citizens, it costs five hundred billion merit points.

And for Tenth-Level Citizens to be promoted to Eleventh-Level Citizens, it requires spending five hundred trillion merit points.

So far, the Eleventh-Level Citizen is already the highest level citizen within human civilization, with only nine supreme beings having achieved this level.

Let alone Eleventh-Level Citizens, even Tenth-Level Citizens, since the opening of the Starry Sea Era, only Lin Yuan himself gathered enough merit points to promote.

The Tenth-Level Citizens of human civilization were ancient citizens before the Starry Sea Era, where the citizen promotion system was different from now, and much simpler.

…

Now, with over one hundred trillion merit points, Lin Yuan meets the requirements for promotion to an Eleventh-Tier Citizen.

As for other requirements for becoming an Eleventh-Level Citizen, such as needing the consensus of the nine supreme beings, there are naturally no problems either.

Soon.

With the consumption of five hundred trillion merit points.

The citizen level of Lin Yuan also changed from ‘Tenth-Level’ to ‘Eleventh-Level’.

“Hmm?”

“No emails have come through?”

Lin Yuan raised his eyebrows; previously, when his citizen level was promoted, numerous emails would be sent from the Central Star Domain, introducing him to many benefits and treatments.

When he was promoted from Ninth-Level Citizen to Tenth-Level Citizen, the President of human civilization even personally contacted Lin Yuan to congratulate him on becoming a Tenth-Level Citizen.

But now being promoted to an Eleventh-Level Citizen?

Just then.

A video request came through.

Lin Yuan took a glance, his expression turning solemn immediately.

“Xuanyuan Supreme.”

Lin Yuan chose to accept the call, and it was indeed the Xuanyuan Supreme on the video.

The first and also the strongest among the human civilization supremes, if there were no Xuanyuan Supreme, even if human civilization had emerged as the last victor from the countless eons challenges emanating from beyond the universe, it would be possible to be divided and consumed by various twelve-tier ultimate beings.

“Lin Yuan.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme was smiling; a middle-aged man with an ancient-looking face, his gaze warm as he looked at Lin Yuan, “Are you wondering why there hasn’t been any other email notifications after your promotion to Eleventh-Level Citizen?”

Lin Yuan listened attentively.

Even though his current combat strength was not weaker than those in the normal Path Splitting Realm, in front of the first supreme of human civilization, he still held great respect.

“Hahaha.” Xuanyuan Supreme laughed, “Actually, neither the three goddesses nor we had anticipated that the next Eleventh-Level Citizen would appear so quickly.”

“So there was no preparation.”

Not all supremes are Eleventh-Level Citizens.

Even though the tenth supreme being was born within human civilization, to become an Eleventh-Level Citizen still requires gathering the corresponding merit points, though supremes earn these points at an astonishing speed.

Yet, even with that rate, gathering five hundred trillion merit points still requires a lot of time, and possibly battling with alien twelve-tier beings.

According to the speed of supremes like Xia Qin and others being promoted to Eleventh-Level Citizens, a newly promoted supreme would need at least five hundred thousand to one million years to smoothly advance to Eleventh-Level Citizen.

“I also did not anticipate that the ‘Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter’ would be worth so many merit points.” Lin Yuan immediately said.

One hundred trillion merit points… indeed exceeded Lin Yuan’s expectations.

“Your ‘Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter’ will have a profound impact on human civilization; even one hundred trillion merit points are too few,” Xia Qin Supreme shook his head and said.

“Speaking of which, thanks to the ‘Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter’, our human civilization has uncovered more than a dozen deeply hidden ‘spies’.” A smile appeared on Xia Qin Supreme’s face.

“Spies?” Lin Yuan immediately understood.

It must have been using the ‘Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter’ as bait to ‘fish’ for those alien spies.

“I digress.” Xuanyuan Supreme looked at Lin Yuan, and said: “I came to see you personally to tell you about the powers that our human civilization’s Eleventh-Tier Citizens will enjoy.”

“Eleventh-Tier Citizens have unprecedented influence on human civilization, so as an Eleventh-Level Citizen, you can take away any treasure you want from the Human Civilization Treasury, as long as you need it.”
